column4: I came across an old photo of our class.
column5: 我偶然翻到一张我们班的老照片。

column4: The question came up in the meeting.
column5: 这个问题在会上被提了出来。

column4: How did the accident come about?
column5: 事故是怎么发生的?

column4: It all comes down to hard work.
column5: 这一切归根结底取决于努力。

column4: The problem boils down to a lack of time.
column5: 问题归根结底是缺少时间。

column4: The police crack down on unsafe driving.
column5: 警方严厉打击不安全驾驶。

column4: We cut back on fast food last year.
column5: 我们去年减少了快餐的消费。

column4: I need to catch up on sleep this weekend.
column5: 这个周末我得补补觉。

column4: We all chip in to buy her a gift.
column5: 我们凑钱给她买礼物。

column4: The wind died down in the evening.
column5: 傍晚风渐渐停了。

column4: It dawned on me that I left my keys at school.
column5: 我突然意识到钥匙落在学校了。

column4: You must face up to the mistake.
column5: 你必须勇敢面对这个错误。

column4: Our travel plan fell through at last.
column5: 我们的旅行计划最终落空了。

column4: The teacher gets the idea across with a picture.
column5: 老师用一张图把概念讲清楚了。

column4: We get by on a little money each month.
column5: 我们每月靠一点钱勉强过活。

column4: You will get over the fear of speaking English.
column5: 你会克服说英语的恐惧的。

column4: The flowers give off a sweet smell.
column5: 这些花散发香甜的气味。

column4: Let's go over the new words again.
column5: 我们把生词再过一遍吧。

column4: The two sides iron out their differences.
column5: 双方消除了分歧。

column4: I jot down the phone number on paper.
column5: 我把电话号码匆匆记在纸上。

column4: He walks so fast that I can't keep up with him.
column5: 他走得太快,我跟不上。

column4: The factory laid off fifty workers.
column5: 工厂裁掉了五十名工人。

column4: The old man lives on a small pension.
column5: 老人靠微薄的养老金生活。

column4: I look back on my school days with a smile.
column5: 我微笑着回顾我的学生时代。

column4: We narrow down the choices to three.
column5: 我们把选择范围缩小到三个。

column4: Please pass the message on to your classmates.
column5: 请把消息转告给你的同学们。

column4: The city phases out old buses.
column5: 这座城市在逐步淘汰旧公交车。

column4: I ran into an old friend at the airport.
column5: 我在机场偶遇一位老朋友。

column4: We saw through his little trick at once.
column5: 我们一眼就看穿了他的小把戏。

column4: Set aside ten minutes for reading each day.
column5: 每天留出十分钟阅读。

column4: They set off for the mountain early in the morning.
column5: 他们一大早就出发去山里了。

column4: She set out to build a small library for kids.
column5: 她着手为孩子们建一个小图书馆。

column4: True friends stand by you in hard times.
column5: 真正的朋友在困难时支持你。

column4: You should stand up for your own rights.
column5: 你应该维护自己的权利。

column4: The headmaster will step down next year.
column5: 校长明年将卸任。

column4: We step up training before the final game.
column5: 决赛前我们加紧训练。

column4: Please sum up the story in three sentences.
column5: 请用三句话总结这个故事。

column4: She takes on the hardest part of the work.
column5: 她承担了工作中最难的部分。

column4: The police tracked down the lost bike in a day.
column5: 警方一天内就追查到了丢失的自行车。

column4: The long trip wore me out.
column5: 漫长的旅行把我累坏了。

column4: We wound up the party with a song.
column5: 我们以一首歌结束了聚会。
